title: Chapter 770 Help; Heal!
content:
Chapter 770 Help; Heal!

Chapter 770 Help; Heal!

To Lin Fan, these treasures were of no use at all.

However, Lin Fan kept them all.

At the same time, he had a better impression of Kane.

Lin Fan saw Kaien's anxiety and decided to help him.

Thus, a massive amount of spiritual energy spread out in all directions again.

Not long after, he focused his attention on a purple fruit that was suffused with traces of soul energy.

Under Lin Fan's silent guidance, the two of them soon arrived in front of the fruit.

"Soul Fruit!" Kaien exclaimed in surprise.

He hurried forward and plucked the Soul Fruit.

Then, he said apologetically," Fellow Daoist Lin, what I need is the Heavenly Soul Fruit. However, this Soul Fruit might be of some use to me. So, can I take it?"

After all, he had initially said that he only wanted the Heavenly Soul Fruit.

Now, he wanted the Soul Fruit, he went back on his word.

This was the fruit that Lin Fan had guided him over. Naturally, he wouldn't care about it. However, he had thought that this was the Heaven Soul Fruit. Who would have thought that it was the Soul Fruit?

"Of course, I've already taken a lot of things."

"Thank you," Kaien said.

The two of them continued to move forward in the mystic realm.

Along the way, they encountered a few ferocious beast attacks and obtained a few treasures.

However, Kaien never found the Heavenly Soul Fruit.

This made Kane's face filled with disappointment.

Until... The mystic realm ended.

Lin Fan asked," Pardon me for asking. What do you need the Heaven Soul Fruit for?"

Kaien sighed." My wife's Heavenly Soul is incomplete. She needs the Heavenly Soul Fruit to recover. Otherwise, she might keep fainting."

"But now that I have the Soul Fruit, it might be of some use."

As he said this, his gaze became firm.

She didn't know if he was comforting her or if he was really confident.

Lin Fan asked," Is the Heaven Soul damaged? I have some experience in the soul. Perhaps I can help you a little."

"Really? That's great!" Kaien said excitedly.

Kane was obviously very concerned about his wife's health.

After coming out of the secret ground, he brought Lin Fan and headed towards Planet Hengtong, which was tens of millions of kilometers away.

His wife was resting there.

When Kaien and Lin Fan arrived at an elegant manor, a large group of men in black who gave off a ferocious aura surrounded the manor.

Seeing this…

"Bastard!" Kaien shouted.

He shot forward like a sharp arrow, killing rows of men in black.

"Didn't you go to the Fire Spirit Mystic Realm?" The black-robed man closest to the door asked in shock. Why did you come back so quickly?"

Obviously, Kane's whereabouts had long been known.

Under normal circumstances, the Fire Spirit Secret Realm would only open after a month.

In other words, Kane would only be able to return after at least a month.

However, what they had not expected was that Lin Fan had opened the Fire Spirit Secret Realm ahead of time.

"Bang!"

"Bang!"

A dull sound was heard.

All the black-robed men present were beheaded.

Kane seized the time and jumped into the room.

When he saw his wife lying calmly on the bed, he heaved a sigh of relief.

Before Cain left, he set up some protective magic circles around the bed.

In addition, he had rushed back in time.

Therefore, everything was still under control.

" Lina," Kaien said." I found the Soul Fruit. You'll recover soon."

As he spoke, he turned the Soul Fruit into a ball of purple gas and flew into Lina's mouth.

"Phew!"

"Suck!"

Kaien was extremely nervous, and his breathing became rapid.

He saw…

Lina's eyelids twitched slightly, and she opened her mouth slightly.

He was awake!

Lina woke up!

"It's me, I'm here!" Kane said excitedly. I'm here!"

Lina opened her mouth but soon fell asleep again.

"Lena! Lena!" Kane shouted anxiously.

However, no matter how he called out, Lina did not respond.

Lin Fan, who was standing behind him, said," His Heavenly Soul is severely damaged. The Soul Fruit just now only activated a little bit of his Heavenly Soul."

"Fellow Daoist Lin, do you have a way to save Lina?" Kaien asked.

His eyes were filled with anticipation and hope.

Lin Fan said," There shouldn't be any problems."

In fact, it was not just no problem.

This was a piece of cake for Lin Fan.

"Then I'll have to trouble Fellow Daoist Lin," Kaien said.

Lin Fan nodded.

He raised his hand and pointed at Lina.

A vigorous light of life quickly entered Lina's body like spring water.

Suddenly, golden light surrounded Lina.

After a while, she opened her eyes.

"Kane…"

"It's me, I'm here!" Kaien said.

Lina threw herself into Kane's arms.

"That's great, you're fine!" Kaien said excitedly.

After they separated, Kaien said to Lin Fan," Fellow Daoist Lin, thank you. Thank you so much!"

Lin Fan waved his hand," It's nothing. You don't have to be so polite."

"You two have a good reunion. I'm going to do something," she said after a pause.

"Work? On Hengtong Planet?" Kane asked.

"Yes."  Lin Fan nodded.

That's right!

It was to do things on Hengtong planet.

That was because when Lin Fan arrived at the Hengtong planet, he suddenly realized that there was actually a pearl on this planet.

Perhaps this was the good karma.

" I'm on Planet Hengtong," Kaien said." I have some abilities. I'll go with you."

Lin Fan had saved his wife. Kaien was already thinking about how to report this.

Now, perhaps, it was an opportunity.

What kind of cultivation state was Lin Fan at?

Why would he need help when he was working on a planet?

However, he could see Kane's sincerity.

If he refused, Kane would probably be bothered for a long time.

" Okay!"  Lin Fan replied.

Kane helped Lina adjust her breathing for a moment to make sure she was fine. Then, he set up a defensive array around the house.

Only then did he head south with Lin Fan.

At first, Kane's expression was very relaxed.

However, as they continued to move forward, Kane's face gradually became serious and nervous.

When he saw Lin Fan preparing to walk towards a tall mountain gate, Kaien couldn't help but ask," Fellow Daoist Lin, are you going to Sea Sky Pavilion?"

Lin Fan said," Are you talking about the sect in front?" That should be it."

Kaien hurriedly said," Fellow Daoist Lin, you might not know this, but the Sea Sky Pavilion looks righteous on the surface, but it's actually extremely sinister. Their pavilion master has a very powerful force in the pavilion. They were the ones who wanted to hurt my wife just now."
